hosts.reported_from: Imported timber (red oak log), Keelung to Nagoya; not verified living-tree host

host_note: Browne (1985:294–295) described beetles intercepted in Japan from a Quercus ('red oak') log shipped from Keelung. This does not demonstrate an established Taiwanese population or attack on a living tree.

taxonomic_history.name: Platypus octodentatus
taxonomic_history.note: Directly checked Browne 1985:294–295; original Japanese-port interception.
